content.text: No audit, inspection, verification, or records-examination right binding the Customer exists anywhere in this Agreement.

input.quote: Customer agrees to provide all reasonable and necessary access, support and cooperation for Kubient to provide the Services in a timely and effective manner.
input.rationale: We reviewed the entire Agreement (single Preamble section, p0000–p0074) for any audit, inspection, verification, records-examination or usage-review right running against the Customer, including the fee/revenue-share mechanics (p0023), the use-of-service restrictions (p0025), the data/security warranties (p0035, p0045) and general provisions (p0063–p0073). None exists: Kubient has no right to audit AP, no right of entry, no right to examine AP's books or systems, and no discrepancy/cost-shifting mechanic. The only access language is the cooperation covenant in p0001, which is access needed for Kubient to deliver the Services, not an audit or inspection right, and p0025 restricts (rather than grants) third-party access to the Service. Impressions being "as measured by Kubient" (p0009) is a measurement convention, not an audit right against AP. Because there is no audit right binding the Customer at all, the position is more protective than the preferred checklist (no frequency, notice, business-hours, independent-auditor, cost-shifting or system-access exposure), so nothing is flagged and no redline is proposed; inserting audit machinery would only create an exposure that does not presently exist.
